senses.definition: The feeding relationships between species in a biotic community.
senses.example: Nanomaterials, substances broken down by technology into molecule-size particles, are starting to enter the food chain through well-known food products and their packaging, but there is little acknowledgment by the companies using them, according to a new report from a nonprofit group that works to enhance corporate accountability.
With my promotion this month I will continue my steady journey to the top of the food chain.
